spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help today?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hello, I’m Bronwen MacLeod. I’m really unhappy about money I sent to someone pretending to be from the bank.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Bronwen. Before I look into anything on your account, could you tell me your full name, date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Bronwen MacLeod, 14th of March 1952, and 27 King Street.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s all verified. Can you tell me a little more about what happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: A man called saying there was fraud on my account and talked me into transferring £2,400 to a safe account. I only realised afterwards it was a scam.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m very sorry, that sounds distressing. I’ll log this as a complaint about the transfer and how this has affected you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t really understand online banking. My son normally does it for me in passing, but he wasn’t there when this happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that, Bronwen. I understand this has been difficult.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s left me feeling like the bank just let this happen.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see why you’re upset. I’ll take ownership of the complaint and make sure it’s passed to our complaints team for review.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send it to them today, and I’ll personally call you by 5pm tomorrow to confirm it’s been received. You’ll hear back from us within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I hope someone looks into it properly.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I’m sorry you’ve had to deal with this. Thank you for speaking with me today, Bronwen.
